description: 2026-09-18 floor session, CHAIR approach. Drive to the nearest confirmed semantic track of a chair at 0.4 m/s (the operating floor) and stop at the default gap: gap_min(chair) rounded up to 0.1 m, 0.5 m at the current stack_params, resolved at load. mpc_corr latches the stop at object_reach_tol_m + object_stop_distance_m past that gap, so expect the car's front to REST about 0.59-0.63 m from the chair's near edge (rig, measured and longest-measured braking), up to 0.67 m with 5 cm of track jitter; never inside 0.5. Same requirements as go_to_chair.json. See docs/procedures/2026-09-18_go_to_floor.md.
